scope: Proposed full-suite study for the two active AGIW machines (MacBook Pro and Windows PC); not a results export or machine admission

workflows.local_direct: Same local model stages, runtime, task checks and budgets without the AGIW orchestration path
workflows.agiw: AGIW orchestration path using those matched local stages
workflows.cloud_direct: Direct cloud workflow with independently recorded provider/model differences; not a same-model causal control

jev_treatment.definition: Fixed pre/post stages, findings policy, repair bound and stop rule across workflows; include failed Jev calls in time, usage and cost

metrics.speed: Accepted tasks/minute over whole workload; report full-request completion tokens/s and first-visible-text latency separately
metrics.accuracy: Passed tasks / attempted tasks; retain task-oracle and execution failures, unrun cases and grading coverage
metrics.quality: Independent blinded fixed-rubric scores, distribution and coverage
metrics.elapsed_time: End-to-end seconds, median/tail request latency and workload makespan including allowed checks/repairs
metrics.energy: Task-aligned gross joules/Wh for declared hardware coverage; separate valid idle-adjusted values
metrics.tokens_used_and_saved: Provider-reported input/output/reasoning/cache categories with non-overlapping definitions and all attempts; matched savings require comparable accounting
metrics.dollars_spent: Actual attributable USD and separately labeled dated estimates; provider, electricity and hardware costs separate

comparison_rules: Pair within client host, workload version, Jev setting and cold/warm group; do not infer a hardware ranking from unmatched models or settings.

An attempted task is one unique workload task-trial started in a condition. Retries and repairs remain within that trial; execution failures count against task acceptance and never-started cases remain unknown.
Cloud host names describe the client only; cloud-serving hardware and energy remain unknown unless actually provided.
Keep declared warmups separate and retain their cost; include failures and repairs in attempted-work accounting.
Unreported token categories, partial power coverage and unknown charges remain unknown, never zero.
Keep provider-reported, locally counted and estimated tokens distinct. Different tokenizers limit cross-provider token-savings interpretation.
A baseline must be positive and both matched measurements known before calculating percentage savings; retain negative changes.
This protocol does not populate, supersede or reclassify historical benchmark observations.

supersedes.reason: Linux node (Mac Pro 5,1) retired from AGIW by Louis on 2026-10-25; AGIW now runs on the MacBook Pro and the Windows PC only. Linux conditions are removed, not measured or carried as null placeholders.

design.repeat_policy: Same per-condition trial counts as the prepared 18-condition protocol (54 exploratory / 162 repeated executor trials = 3 exploratory and 9 repeated per condition): 36 exploratory and 108 repeated executor trials across 12 conditions. Warmups and exploratory trials are reported separately from repeated trials.
